topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 59 project-authored contract(s) across 6 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 8 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 10 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc2771context, synthereumpoolmigrationto, synthereumpoolmigration). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
